content.text: The plain induction doesn't go through: `weave (x :: xs) ys` recurses on `weave ys xs`, which swaps the arguments. So I'll strengthen the statement to allow lengths that differ by at most one (`|xs| = |ys|` or `|xs| = |ys| + 1`), and induct on `|xs| + |ys|`.

input.old_string:
theorem deal_weave (xs ys : List α) (h : xs.length = ys.length) : deal (weave xs ys) = (xs, ys) := by
  sorry
input.new_string:
theorem deal_weave (xs ys : List α) (h : xs.length = ys.length) : deal (weave xs ys) = (xs, ys) := by
  -- Strengthened statement: the recursive call swaps the arguments, so the
  -- lengths may differ by one. Induct on the total length.
  have key : ∀ n : Nat, ∀ xs ys : List α, xs.length + ys.length ≤ n →
      (xs.length = ys.length ∨ xs.length = ys.length + 1) →
      deal (weave xs ys) = (xs, ys) := by
    intro n
    induction n with
    | zero =>
      intro xs ys hn hc
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
        cases ys with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons y ys => simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hn; omega
      | cons x xs =>
        simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hn; omega
    | succ k ih =>
      intro xs ys hn hc
      cases xs with
      | nil =>
        cases ys with
        | nil => rfl
        | cons y ys =>
          simp only [List.length_cons, List.length_nil] at hc
          -- hc : 0 = ys.length + 1 ∨ 0 = ys.length + 1 + 1 ... impossible or ys.length = 0
          -- handled below by generic argument
          have hy : ys = [] := by
            cases ys with
            | nil => rfl
            | cons z zs => simp only [List.length_cons] at hc; omega
          subst hy
          rfl
      | cons x xs =>
        have h' := ih ys xs
          (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn hc ⊢; omega)
          (by simp only [List.length_cons] at hn hc ⊢; omega)
        rw [weave, deal, h']
        rfl
  exact key (xs.length + ys.length) xs ys (Nat.le_refl _) (Or.inl h)

content.text: Two fixes: `weave` is well-founded so `rfl` can't unfold it (use `simp [weave, deal]`), and `rw` already closes the cons goal, so the trailing `rfl` should go.
